verdict.rationale: CDP documents deposit destinations: stable onchain addresses that customers or external parties send to, with the corresponding custodial account credited automatically. This gives first-party, address-level routing of incoming funds, optionally with auto-liquidation. The docs do not show that a developer can provision one address per customer, attach a customer label or metadata, or reconcile deposits back to a specific customer, so per-customer attribution is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit per-customer address or virtual-account provisioning, customer labels/metadata on deposits, fiat named virtual accounts, documented reconciliation or attribution in deposit events, independent corroboration.
